notes: Life after the Merge (doc 58 v1.1 §3, M78.2): what a GPU rig or a Larkspur unit can earn once Ethereum mining ends. Gross dollars per day per 60 MH/s of 3060 Ti-equivalent, interpolated linearly by date between the points (before the first point the first value holds; after the last the last holds). Power is charged as usual, so at Act II power prices this is a net loss for most sites. That is the point.

points.source: Tom's Hardware, net -0.04 a day at $0.10/kWh on 16 Sep 2022 (doc 60 §4)
designed, bounded by the Sep 2022 and Jun 2023 points

rental.source: designed, bounded by gpu_rental.csv (doc 60); host fee 0% [A, Vast.ai FAQ]; utilisation from guides, not platform data. Gen 1 (RX 580-class) earns half the Gen 2 rate and half its utilisation. Larkspur units cannot be rented.
